landing.text: {visited_bridge?The bridge still sways behind you.|You did not come by the bridge.} The far bank is quiet, {player_name}. A lantern hangs from a post at the head of a muddy path.

choices.label: Call out to the stranger you helped

call.text: Your voice carries over the water. Somewhere behind you, a voice you almost recognise answers: this way.

e_go.text: The path ends at a jetty. At the end of the jetty an iron arm holds a ship's bell. Below it, the ferry is waiting, engine ticking in the dark.
